summary: GCT Semiconductor Holding, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) to increase its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program from $75M to $120M in common stock under a sales agreement dated April 1, 2025, with agents B. Riley Securities and H.C. Wainwright. The filing is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not a special situation. Shares are listed on NYSE under GCTS, with the last sale at $2.61 on June 15, 2026. Agents receive up to 3.0% commission; no escrow or trust arrangement exists. No stated use of proceeds beyond general corporate purposes. At-the-market offerings are ordinary-course financing, not a transformative event.
